text:
julia: Noticed staging publish failed after the typegen bump. regen diffs in sample-app and sdk-ts.

ci-bot: build 1977.24 failed - regendiff in `sdk-ts/src/clients/session.ts`
ci-bot: ```
--- a/sdk-ts/src/clients/session.ts
+++ b/sdk-ts/src/clients/session.ts
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@
- export const DEFAULT_SESSION = { keepAlive: false, retries: 2 }
+ export const DEFAULT_SESSION = { retries: 2, keepAlive: true }
```

sam.engineer: Repro locally. The OpenAPI had an accidental `x-sdk-defaults: keepAlive: true` added in a typegen PR. That made codegen emit a different literal order and a behavioral default change. Some sample-app tests assert the stringified options so they flake.

parker: Semver: changing default behavior is breaking for patch releases. We should revert the metadata and treat this as a minor unless it's documented.

olga: I'll prep a small hotfix: revert the OpenAPI edit and add a lint in the typegen CI that fails on unexpected x-sdk-defaults entries. Also add property sorting in the generator to avoid spurious reorders.

julia: Also saw the release-stamp step tried to write version 3.1.0 while CHANGELOG still showed 3.0.9 because regen failed mid-flight. We need atomic stamping.

release-bot: Action items created: #3621 revert x-sdk-defaults, #3622 release-stamp atomic lock, #3623 regen-smoke test. Assigned to @olga and @sam.engineer.

sam.engineer: I'll add a tiny smoke test in sample-app that runs `node ./bin/sample --dump-config` and diffs against golden to catch defaults or ordering changes. Put it in the regen check.

julia: Good. Once revert PR lands we'll re-run regen and publish. Thanks all. :pray:
